redfin.remarks: Experience comfortable city living in this incredible condo in the heart of Century City. This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offers approximately 1,187 square feet of living space and a fantastic open floor plan designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The well appointed kitchen features granite countertops , stainless steel appliances including a refrigerator, dishwasher, and stove, along with a convenient bar counter that flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas. The bright living room showcases engineered hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and a decorative fireplace , with sliding doors that open to a private balcony offering pleasant views and a great indoor-outdoor feel. Both bedrooms are generously sized (primary has engineered hardwood floors and secondary has carpet) with ensuite bathrooms for added comfort and privacy. The primary suite features a walk-in closet, an additional sliding door closet, and its own corner balcony providing an extra outdoor retreat. Additional highlights include central heating and air conditioning, in-unit laundry, and two separate parking spaces. Residents also enjoy access to an incredible rooftop terrace with panoramic city views. Ideally located just moments from world-class shopping and dining at Westfield Century City and convenient to Beverly Hills, Santa Monica, and West Hollywood, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and prime Westside location.
